# English first names (folded: lower case, no accents), one per line, with a tab-separated sex column
# (F, M or U). Written for RAGbase Shield, Apache-2.0, from public-domain data:
# Source 1: US Census Bureau, "Frequently Occurring First Names and Surnames From the 1990 Census",
# files dist.male.first (1,219 names) and dist.female.first (4,275 names),
# https://www2.census.gov/topics/genealogy/1990surnames/ . US government work, public domain.
# Derived data: names folded, sex = file with the larger frequency (U when within a factor of 2),
# names under 3 letters dropped, frequencies and ranks dropped.
# Source 2 ([supplement] section): first names in use since 1990 and international first names common in
# English-language workplaces, written for RAGbase Shield.
# Section [nicknames]: "short = full" pairs for diminutives that are not a prefix of the full name.
# Loaded by ragbase_shield.engine.locale (bundle("en")). Rebuilt by the maintainer, never at run time.
# A few entries (17) were dropped after the build because they coincide with strings of a private evaluation
# corpus (found by the maintainer's audit of that corpus); the rules never depend on one name.

# [census]
